name: Welcome and get them in
when_it_runs: Within 2 hours, then day 2 and day 5 if they have not logged in.
what_we_offer: Nothing. Do not sell anything in the first week.

name: First subject done
trigger_in_plain_words: Logged in but has not finished a subject.
when_it_runs: Weekly for the first four weeks.
success_measure: Percentage completing a subject in 30 days

name: Keep the pace
trigger_in_plain_words: On the syllabus but behind the pace their exam needs.
owner: Automated, counsellor if momentum is low twice running
what_we_offer: Doubt session or a revision class.
success_measure: Percentage still on pace 30 days later
blocked_by: Attempt on file plus watch time

name: Bring back the drifter
when_it_runs: Once, then a call if no reply in 5 days.
what_we_offer: Extension if the reason is time. Deferral to a later attempt if the reason is life.

name: Exam run-up
success_measure: Percentage attempting at least one mock

name: Result day
when_it_runs: On result day and the two days after.
owner: Automated first, counsellor on every reply
success_measure: Percentage of the cohort whose result we now know
blocked_by: Result dates in the exam calendar

name: Passed, sell the next level
trigger_in_plain_words: They tell us they passed and the ladder has a next step.
when_it_runs: Same day, then day 3, day 7, day 14, day 21.
what_we_offer: CFA L2 or L3, FRM Part 2, CA Final.
success_measure: Percentage buying the next level in 21 days

name: Passed, ladder finished
trigger_in_plain_words: They passed the last level we teach.
when_it_runs: Same day, then day 7 and day 30.
the_one_thing_we_want: A second product or a referral.
what_we_offer: Analyst Stack, Stock Market, Excel and Python.
success_measure: Second-product rate and referrals per student

name: Next attempt
trigger_in_plain_words: They tell us they did not pass.
what_we_offer: Extension for the next window, or a re-enrol at the loyalty price.
price_band: 1,000 per month, or 10 percent off a fresh enrolment
success_measure: Percentage committing to the next attempt

name: Validity running out
when_it_runs: At T-30, T-14, T-3, and once at T+7.
the_one_thing_we_want: Extend, or move to a later attempt.
blocked_by: Validity expiry date on the record

name: Win back
trigger_in_plain_words: Inactive and no attempt on file.
when_it_runs: One sequence of three messages, then stop for six months.
the_one_thing_we_want: Tell us where you are with the qualification.
